summary.en: After drinking with a friend who hasn't met for ten years, Kogoro falls asleep on a train and awakens to find himself a person that is willing to go on a date with him. When she stops at home though, she finds a person murdered and causes Kogoro and Conan to start seeking out whether she's guilty or if someone else is involved. Victim: Kazumi Takenaka Cause of death: Stab wound in chest Suspects: Sachiko Shimamura
